identificationModule.officialTitle: Novel Autologou CAR-T Therapy for Relapsed/Refractory B Cell Lymphoma

primaryOutcomes.description: complete remission rate after treated by CAR-T therapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: every 3 months until 20 months after the last patient's enrollment

secondaryOutcomes.description: from date of inclusion to date of progression, relapse, or death from any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the day of treatment to the date of first documented progression，up to 20 months after the last patient's enrollment

secondaryOutcomes.description: from the date of inclusion to date of death, irrespective of cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 20 months after the last patient's enrollment

secondaryOutcomes.description: any unfavorable and unintended sign , symptom, or disease temporally associated with the use of a medical treatment or procedure that may or may not be considered related to the medical treatment or procedure
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the date of the start of treatment to 20 months after last patient's enrollment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: duration of the modified T cells by CAR-T in the patients
secondaryOutcomes.description: time from re-transfusion to date when the modified T cells become non-detectable.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the date of re-transfusison to 20 months after last patient's enrollment
